errors.text: The proposed Sc/Zr alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
No prior experimental evidence or citations support the claim that Sc or Zr would suppress intermetallic formation or jointly improve corrosion and oxidation resistance in this alloy system.
The hypothesis omits the target composition, SPS pressure-assisted processing, the 800–1000 °C sintering window, and the magnesium-volatilization upper boundary.
It does not identify the dense microstructure and uniformly distributed AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases that mediate the target improvements.
Predictions are purely directional and omit relative density, hardness, oxidation rate constants, corrosion potential, and corrosion-current benchmarks.
The falsification experiment lacks controlled Sc/Zr concentrations, matched processing conditions, quantitative acceptance thresholds, and explicit electrochemical or oxidation-kinetic signatures.
